summary: Goldman Sachs Private Credit Corp. filed an 8-K reporting routine unregistered sales of equity securities under Rule 506(b)/Regulation D and a regular monthly distribution declaration. The company sold ~4.3M Class I, ~59k Class S, and an undisclosed number of Class D shares for aggregate consideration of ~$106.8M. The board declared a $0.1850/share distribution for March 2026, payable May 6. There is no acquisition, restructuring, delisting, tender, or other special situation. This is a standard periodic funding update for a BDC.
